designDetails.silhouette: Inherit the V66 Lurker: long smooth compressed dome, lean narrow torso, long clawed arms, digitigrade rear legs, four stable dorsal tubes and exactly one complete segmented spear tail; locomotion remains low and may use four contacts.
designDetails.palette: Warm pearl-ivory and pale gray-beige shell, cool blue-gray biomechanical recesses, restrained translucent rose-taupe tissues, dark desaturated joint cavities, moist highlights and metallic silver/ivory teeth.
designDetails.surface: Pale biomechanical ribs, tendons, dome underside and tube articulation remain readable through material and value contrast. The albino surface is newly authored rather than a filtered, recolored or copied base bitmap.
designDetails.anatomy: One eyeless smooth domed head with double jaw, one narrow ribbed torso, two elongated arms, two digitigrade hind legs, four dorsal tubes and exactly one continuous articulated tail. No equipment.
designDetails.orientation: Strict orthographic gameplay profile facing RIGHT in all 32 poses; skull, jaws, four limbs, dorsal tubes and complete tail stay inside their cell without camera rotation.
designDetails.scale: Inherit enemy-011's final pack scale 0.333702348 and source calibration idle 1.000000, move 1.062929, attack 1.858278 and death 1.822337. Compare dome and thorax landmarks, never the changing tail arc, pounce reach or crouch height.
designDetails.root: Inherit the reviewed pelvis center immediately ahead of the tail base at the proximal rear-leg joint and its projection to the supporting floor. Tail tip, dome and extended claws never redefine the physical root.
designDetails.background: True transparent RGBA when available, otherwise perfectly uniform pure #FF00FF; no shadow, scene, hive resin, text, logo or grid.
